summary: Phase 2 Solid Clean (public website + staff RBAC + booking → Stripe) testing complete. Backend: 14/14 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_solid_clean_phase2.py all green covering: (1) /api/public/solid-clean/config has brand phone 020 3728 4419, logo /brand/solidclean-logo.png and NO 'parking'/'airbnb' leak; (2) public /reviews returns empty list (demo reviews filtered out, no 'demo' key leaks); (3) unauth GET on /api/admin/{leads,overview,bookings,settings,policies} all return 401; (4) /api/public/solid-clean/contact creates a lead with source='website' visible in /admin/leads; (5) end-to-end booking POST /api/public/solid-clean/bookings with service=regular, postcode=CR0 1AA, 2BR/1BA/1LR returns a checkout_url that starts with https://checkout.stripe.com/, booking is persisted and appears in owner's /api/admin/bookings?status=pending_payment with customer email matching; (6) service base price edit via PUT /admin/settings reflects on /api/public/solid-clean/quote/preview immediately and is restored on teardown (confirmed booking's total not retested since snapshotted into the booking doc at insert time); (7) staff RBAC: owner creates TEST_Cleaner staff -> staff login -> GET /admin/bookings returns only bookings where assigned_to==staff_uid; GET /admin/leads, /admin/overview, /admin/settings all 403; GET /admin/policies 200; PATCH on a non-assigned booking 403; PATCH own assigned booking with assigned_to in body also 403 (staff cannot reassign); staff deactivated on teardown; (8) owner regression: /admin/overview, /admin/leads, /admin/settings all 200; (9) platform regression: /platform/companies, /platform/plans both 200. Frontend (Playwright): HomePage loads with correct logo + phone (020 3728 4419) + brand green #023F00, hero Book-a-Cleaning + Get-a-Quote buttons present and route to /quote, zero /admin or /login links in public page HTML. /services renders 4 service cards. /reviews shows site-reviews-empty testid and zero review cards. /privacy, /cookies, /terms all show policy-pending with 'being finalised'. /contact form submits and shows contact-success. /admin while logged-out redirects to /admin/login. Mobile 390px: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth==clientWidth==390), menu button opens mobile nav with Book + Quote buttons. /quote and public HTML contain no 'parking' or 'airbnb' tokens. /admin/login page has no 'signup' / 'sign up' text.
action_items: Container date is October 2026 (future). Availability window is max_advance_days=60. The phase2 test loops days 2..60 to find a bookable slot, so it is portable, but main agent should be aware if real 'today' moves further.
Phase2 test leaves one booking in 'abandoned' status per run (release endpoint called in fixture teardown). Harmless and not shown by default /admin/bookings query (status $nin abandoned).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_admin.py:154 patch_booking - staff rule 'body.status != completed or body.assigned_to is not None' means staff can PATCH only with status='completed' and no assigned_to; attempts to send status='confirmed' or 'cancelled' return 403. This matches the spec ('may only mark own job completed') but UI must not show other actions to staff.

routes_saas.py:215 list_staff uses require_admin (not require_owner). Because /api/admin/staff is NOT in STAFF_PATHS, the require_admin dependency itself 403s for staff role before the handler runs - correct, but defence-in-depth would be to use require_owner explicitly.

routes_public.py:282 stripe_webhook still uses json.loads(str(event['data']['object'])) (brittle round-trip via Python repr). Prefer event['data']['object'].to_dict(). Carried forward from iterations 1 & 2.

routes_public.py:189 create_booking accepts arbitrary quote_id from body without verifying it belongs to the same lead/company; find_one is tenant-scoped so cross-tenant hijack is blocked, but a malicious caller inside the same tenant could reuse another customer's quote_id and overwrite its fields on line 191.
routes_admin.py:146 list_bookings default filter excludes 'abandoned' only; cancelled bookings are returned together with confirmed/pending - owner UI should tab-filter. Not a bug but noteworthy.

No rate-limit coverage for /api/public/* (claimed 180/min) was exercised to avoid interfering with testing. Implementation in server.py middleware appears to use IP + path prefix - visually inspected, matches spec.

SiteLayout.jsx Header renders CleanOps dark login panel on /admin/login but the Sign-in button is a plain <button>, not type='submit'. Clicking still works via onClick in AdminLogin.jsx, but Enter-to-submit may not; low priority.

success_rate.backend: 100% (14/14 phase2 + 13/13 phase1 + prior saas all green)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Full Solid Clean regression lives in /app/backend/tests/test_solid_clean_phase{1,2}.py (27 tests) + /app/backend/tests/test_saas.py (34 tests). Phase2 uses booking_and_cleanup fixture that loops availability over the next 60 days to tolerate container-date drift. Staff fixture auto-deactivates. Container date observed as Oct 2026 (future), so avoid hard-coding future ISO dates > container_today+60. Stripe test key is live in backend/.env (test mode) and returns a real checkout.stripe.com URL - do not actually complete payment in automated runs (would create real test-mode sessions). Public rate limits: 180/min /api/public/*, 60/min /api/auth/* - phase2 keeps all public requests well under this.
